de.name: Lalibela cultural Center
de.text: Diese kulturelle Einrichtung in Lalibela stellt Artefakte und die Geschichte rund um die berühmten Felsenkirchen aus.

de.name: Southwestern Group
de.text: Dieser Komplex aus monolithischen Felsenkirchen ist Teil des weltberühmten äthiopisch-orthodoxen Weltkulturerbes in Lalibela.

de.name: Northwestern Group
de.text: Diese markante Gruppe historischer Felsenkirchen in Lalibela wurde direkt aus dem Grundgestein gehauen.

hu.name: Lalibela cultural Center
hu.text: Ez a lalibelai kulturális intézmény a híres sziklába vájt templomokhoz kapcsolódó műtárgyakat és történelmet mutatja be.

hu.name: Southwestern Group
hu.text: Ez a monolitikus, sziklába vájt templomokból álló csoport a világhírű lalibelai etióp ortodox világörökségi helyszín része.

hu.name: Northwestern Group
hu.text: A közvetlenül az alapkőzetből kifaragott történelmi sziklatemplomoknak ez a különleges csoportja Lalibelában található.

ro.name: Lalibela cultural Center
ro.text: Această instituție culturală din Lalibela expune artefacte și istoria din jurul faimoaselor biserici săpate în stâncă.

ro.name: Southwestern Group
ro.text: Acest grup de biserici monolitice săpate în stâncă face parte din situl de patrimoniu ortodox etiopian de renume mondial din Lalibela.

ro.name: Northwestern Group
ro.text: Săpat direct din stâncă, acest grup distinct de biserici istorice din stâncă este situat în Lalibela.

en.name: Lalibela cultural Center
en.text: This cultural institution in Lalibela exhibits artifacts and history surrounding the famous rock-hewn churches.

en.name: Southwestern Group
en.text: This cluster of monolithic, rock-hewn churches forms part of the world-renowned Ethiopian Orthodox heritage site in Lalibela.

en.name: Northwestern Group
en.text: Carved directly out of the bedrock, this distinct grouping of historic rock churches is located in Lalibela.
